items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995

ctx.x: You are absolutely my man on that. I absolutely agree with you. I went to a concert of Ellington music in Milwaukee at the Performing Arts Center, which is a gorgeous, © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -17-

modern, I guess they do symphony concerts there and so forth. And Gunther Schuller was conducting. And just before the concert started, he walked around the stage and pulled out every plug. He said, “we’ll have none of this.” And it was just wonderful. God it sounded like the way it was supposed to sound.

We had a similar story from, I forget who told it now, about Illinois Jacquet doing the same thing in Europe. The sound man went through the whole thing, set the levels, and then Illinois said, “now take all your faders and turn them down 50 percent, and don’t touch them again.”
